<description>
Declarations and definitions tend to drift apart. We could align these, and then enforce that via `clang-tidy`s `readability-inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name` check: https://clang.llvm.org/extra/clang-tidy/checks/readability/inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name.html.

This may not be worth the (initial) churn / we may also be fine with inconsistency here. Also need to decide which side to align on in some cases.

Currently drafted, as it's based on changes from #36743 to avoid changing could-be-deleted lines twice.
</description>

<commits>
7beb23f6ce serialize: remove unused unique_ptr<const T> serialization

No serialized object holds a std::unique_ptr<const T>, so these
overloads are never selected.

b4cb6dc460 refactor: make functions only used in their own translation unit static

These functions are declared in a header, but only used in the file that
defines them. Remove the declarations and give them internal linkage.

38f497d04c refactor: use consistent parameter names in declarations and definitions

Enable clang-tidy's readability-inconsistent-declaration-parameter-name
check, and fix the existing differences.
</commits>
